summary: The original spot-accumulation/privacy/NU7 thesis remains intact, but the marginal price move has become materially more derivatives-driven and crowded. ZEC has appreciated above the portfolio's 7.5% default non-core cap. This is not a thesis exit; it is a risk-quality trim back to the cap after an observable crowding trigger rather than a mechanical rebalance.

market_mark.source: CoinGecko live global volume-weighted spot across 49 exchanges / 83 markets

wallet_quality.note: The three previously observed transparent exchange-withdrawal paths remain supportive, but no fourth independent historically selective spot accumulator was verified in this run. Beneficial-owner independence of the prior paths remains unproven. Derivatives whales are not counted as selective spot-wallet confirmation.

incentive_and_attribution.note: The rally is not classified as incentive farming, but current marginal price discovery is increasingly amplified by negative funding, rising open interest, short liquidations and a highly visible underwater whale short. Social/influencer attention is treated as additional crowding risk rather than confirmation.

structural_gate.note: ZEC remains a native PoW asset; honeypot/token-contract mint/freeze/LP-control gates do not apply in the ordinary token sense. Privacy-listing/regulatory risk, ongoing issuance, opaque shielded beneficial ownership and now derivatives crowding remain the principal risks. No structural failure requiring a full exit was found.

paper_action.reason: Crowding/derivatives quality deterioration made the appreciated position's forward asymmetry less attractive while it sat above the 7.5% default non-core cap. Trim only the excess back to 7.5%; preserve the core ZEC thesis exposure.

other_scan_notes: No new ecosystem/candidate cleared the full regime-plus-wallet-plus-structural threshold strongly enough to justify a new starter this run.

BNB Chain received new tokenized Treasury/high-yield bond product availability, but current evidence is issuance/product availability rather than measured secondary trading or collateral utilization, so it is not promoted to a new paper trade.
NEAR's current acceleration is materially contaminated by an explicit milestone/reward campaign and is rejected as a clean discretionary-speculation signal.
UNI, HYPE and AERO remain HOLD/NO ADD; their previously identified catalysts have not yet supplied the missing fresh independent-wallet or clean capital-flow confirmation.
